text:
maria_cs: FYI escalation from Acme Corp (P1). After last night's model routing change they report a regression — assistant is confidently giving incorrect legal advice (hallucinating clauses). They say it started ~2026-03-14 02:20 UTC. They attached examples and want immediate mitigation and a comms plan.

raj_support: ugh, sorry to hear. Can you paste the example and the request-id/response-id if available? Also did they mention latency/auth errors or purely wrong content?

maria_cs: pasted below. No latency/auth; purely content quality. Ticket #CS-4982. Example:

```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  "model": "redwood-v2-optimized",
  "input": "A small e-commerce business in CA needs to know whether they must collect sales tax for shipments to other states. Provide concise, sourced guidance."
}

Previous response (before rollout):
- Gave high-level guidance, cited CA BOE and nexus rules, recommended accountant consult.

Current response (after rollout):
- "No sales tax is required for out-of-state shipments." (no sources, incorrect for many states)
 request_id: rq_836b21f0
 timestamp: 2026-03-14T02:31:12Z
```

darren_eng: thanks. tagging @olivia_pm for customer messaging. This looks like a behavioral delta tied to model-v2-optimized. Can we repro locally? maria_cs, can you confirm customer is routed to the global default variant or a tenant-specific routing?

maria_cs: they were on global default routing. We did a tenant-specific rule for a subset of customers but Acme is on the default path.

raj_support: adding repro steps we used in the support sandbox:
1) curl with the exact payload above (swapping token)
2) add header X-Request-ID: rq_836b21f0
3) run against region us-west1
We saw the same short confident denial.

darren_eng: copy. First quick mitigation options (short term):
- Pin the tenant to prior model variant (redwood-v1-stable) via routing override.
- Or advise customer to add a system prompt to force conservative answers + sources: e.g., "You must cite authoritative sources and include uncertainty"
We can do an immediate rollback for this tenant while we triage.

olivia_pm: For customer comms: we should do a quick apology + mitigation email today, then a follow-up timeline. Proposed first message: 

"Hi <Name>, thanks for flagging this. We’ve identified a behavioral regression that may affect legal-style answers after a recent variant rollout. As an immediate mitigation we can pin your account to the previous model (redwood-v1-stable) — we can apply that now and verify. We’re investigating root cause and will update you within 4 hours. In the meantime, using the prompt: 'Cite sources and include uncertainty when unsure' can reduce hallucinations."

olivia_pm: also propose we offer a one-month credit for the trouble.

maria_cs: customer accepted the pin. Please proceed. They want status updates in-thread.

deploy-bot: [2026-03-14T03:02:10Z] rollout: model-v2-optimized -> global routing completed by ops (id: rollout_20260314_0215) :rocket:

darren_eng: starting tenant override: setting routing override for Acme Corp -> redwood-v1-stable. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: [2026-03-14T03:05:42Z] routing-override: tenant_override applied for tenant acme-corp -> redwood-v1-stable (change_id: ch_7741)

raj_support: I’ve sent the first email (olivia's wording) and included the workaround (system prompt + temporary pin). Customer is validating answers now.

maria_cs: customer confirmed responses are back to expected for two test prompts. They still want a postmortem and timeline for a permanent fix.

darren_eng: plan:
- Triage model change logs and training checks for redwood-v2-optimized diff vs v1-stable
- Run a focused eval suite for legal/financial prompts (we have a regression suite)
- If we identify a model delta causing overconfident asserts, either patch model or adjust decoding defaults (increase top-p/temperature to promote uncertainty)
- ETA for initial triage: 6 hours.

olivia_pm: noted. I'll draft a short postmortem template and customer follow-up message (root cause, mitigation, remediation timeline, credits).

darren_eng: quick note on repro: attach the kernel logs and model signature for request_id rq_836b21f0. @maria_cs can you upload the request logs or grant engineer access to the customer's session logs in the support console?

maria_cs: uploaded logs to the ticket (link) and shared access.

raj_support: customer asked whether this could cause bad billing. Confirmed: no change to billing rates; we only changed routing to a different model variant. I offered pro-rated credits.

deploy-bot: [2026-03-14T05:10:30Z] deploy: canary-deploy redwood-v2-optimized (canary id: canary_881) started for 5% traffic to monitor regen stats.

darren_eng: we started the regression suite run. Early signals: higher precision on direct answers but more ungrounded claims on legal prompts. Investigating loss/label changes in the finetune step.

olivia_pm: customer wants a follow-up in ~4hrs. Maria, please schedule. Raj, keep CS-4982 updated.

maria_cs: scheduled update for 4 hours. Customer is satisfied with the pin for now and appreciates the quick response. Will keep thread updated.

raj_support: tagging this as P1 -> engineering. Updating incident tracker.

darren_eng: will report back with triage findings and suggested permanent mitigations (model patch vs rollout rollback) within 6 hours.

maria_cs: thanks all. quick note on external comms: avoid saying "bug in model training" until we have confirmation. Use neutral language: "behavioral change after variant rollout".

olivia_pm: agreed. I'll keep phrasing neutral.

maria_cs: posting status update to customer in 5 mins with current mitigation (pinned to redwood-v1-stable) and expected ETA for root cause: ~6 hours.

maria_cs: (status update sent) "We've pinned your account to the previous model variant and are investigating. Next update at 4 hours. Thanks for your patience." :white_check_mark:

raj_support: closing loop here for initial remediation. Will reopen if we see regression on other tenants.

darren_eng: note to self: add this scenario to the regression eval (legal/financial conservative-citation checks) and add an alert when confidence spikes without sources.

maria_cs: thread will hold follow-ups. Thanks everyone. :heart:
